audience: software teams who translate the strings of their app with Localazy

useCases.title: See your projects and the files in a project
useCases.text: The AI lists the projects you can reach with source language and your role, and the files inside a project.

useCases.title: Read the translations of a file in one language
useCases.text: The AI reads the strings of one file in one language, with key path and current translation, including plural forms. You can check wording or find gaps.

useCases.title: Get translation suggestions for a string
useCases.text: The AI reads translation memory and machine translation suggestions for one source key in a target language, for example to compare engines.

useCases.title: Read, add or update glossary terms
useCases.text: The AI lists the glossary terms of a project with the term in each language, adds a term, or replaces the content of an existing one.

useCases.title: Submit a translation for a string
useCases.text: The AI sets the translation of one source key in one target language. Depending on your role, it becomes the current version or a suggestion.

useCases.title: Add or update string keys in a file
useCases.text: The AI adds or updates up to 50 string keys in one file and one language, and checks the progress of the import. Nothing is deleted.
